principle: Build shared control-plane capabilities once, then add narrow domain modules on top. Preserve human approval for external, costly, destructive, credential, payment, and vendor actions.

phases.name: Finish current proving ground
phases.objective: Use Run 006 G6 to validate the reusable evidence, reconciliation, approval, alert, and connector patterns before extracting them globally.
items: Complete Run 006 manual G6 E2E after host resize
Validate ChatGPT/SMS alert policy without premature scheduling

phases.name: Personal & Business Operations Core
phases.objective: Create the minimum shared substrate all later managers reuse.
phases.exitCriteria: A new operating module can register sources, ingest normalized evidence, create an exception/decision, route a governed notification, expose health/cost, and recover safely without inventing new shared infrastructure.

phases.name: Cognitive-load reducers
phases.objective: Attack the highest-frequency owner burden first.
phases.exitCriteria: Pending replies, obligations, due items, and billing exceptions surface from one exception/decision layer with low alert noise.

phases.name: Risk and asset administration
phases.objective: Prevent expiration, security, document, and ownership failures.

phases.name: Broader life/business operations
phases.objective: Extend the same architecture only where measured value justifies it.

phases.name: Continuous value review
items: Measure alerts, exceptions caught, prevented losses, owner time saved, cost, false positives, and actual use
Merge or retire low-value or overlapping modules
Feed recurring failure patterns back into Run 007 Thinker
